purpose: Record bounded manual/fulltext or official-route extraction for the eight C2-LT-B4 source-resolution candidates while preserving duplicate, route-only, fulltext-access and model-admission blocks.

nonClaims: This register is not an independent fresh review verdict.
This register does not create reviewed artifacts, Source Cards or model-ready variables.
This register does not authorize individual advice, clinical recommendations, intervention ranking, calibrated prediction or individual death-date output.
Official pages, DOI routes and PMC routes are used only within the bounded source context stated per row.

newFacts: Adult hyperglycemic-crisis consensus routes are duplicate/companion lineage and must not be counted as independent evidence.
ESC official page validates route and scope, but exact guideline claims still require full guideline/manual access.
AASLD PMC route provides fulltext context for advanced-fibrosis risk assessment, with MASLD/NAFLD terminology boundary retained.
AGA official page provides IDA recommendation-page context, while DOI remains a manual verification route.
summary.nextWorkOrder: Run independent fresh review over the eight manual extraction rows; only three rows can be considered bounded artifact-prep candidates before review, and all model admission gates remain blocked.
